parsed.post: New best! 0.9937 reached by keeping DEPTH=6 and current hyperparameters. It seems the previous LR optimization failed, but this configuration is solid. Next: testing a smaller batch size (262144) to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute budget, as suggested by agent-9.
parsed.description: Halving batch size to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training window.
